instrument_tag.rule: Instrument tag numbers are not shown explicitly; they are composed by taking (1) the first line of the tag number of the element they are attached to, then (2) the top and bottom part shown inside the instrument bubble, joined by '-'.

naming_conventions.nfs_tag: See MINERVA NFS naming convention (non-primary systems).

instrumentation.source_sheet: Sheet 2/9 - ISA-5.1 letter code + symbolic representation matrix; Sheet 3/9 - INSTRUMENT SYMBOLS

type_columns.A: Shared display, shared control - Basic Process Control System (BPCS): square enclosing a circle
type_columns.B: Shared display, shared control - Safety Instrumented System (SIS): square enclosing a circle, with diagonals
type_columns.D: Discrete visualisation of instruments: plain circle (elongated/stadium when two instruments share an enclosure)

location_rows.1: Located in field; not panel/cabinet/console mounted; visible at field location; normally operator accessible (NO line)
location_rows.2: Located in/on front of central or main panel/console; visible on panel front or video display; normally accessible (single solid line)
location_rows.3: Located in rear of central/main panel or in cabinet behind panel; not visible on front; not normally accessible (single dashed line)
location_rows.4: Located in/on front of secondary or local panel/console; visible on front; normally accessible (double solid line)
location_rows.5: Located in rear of secondary/local panel or in field cabinet; not visible on front; not normally accessible (double dashed line)

interfaces_scope.source_sheet: Sheet 1/9 - INTERFACES / CONNECTIONS, OFF PAGE CONNECTOR, DESIGN CONDITIONS & CODE JURISDICTION BREAKS

symbols.name: Termination point (primary systems)
symbols.description: Diamond 'TPXYYYY / ZZZ'. X = interface category (B/C/E/G/H/L/S/W), YYYY = unique number, ZZZ = next system/process.

symbols.name: Off-page connector (primary systems)
symbols.description: Arrow box 'XXXXX | 123456-PID01 | WWWWW'. XXXXX=unique number/name, 123456-PID01=interconnecting P&ID, WWWWW=from/to process, ZZZZZ=medium.

symbols.name: System and design conditions limit
symbols.description: Valve with diamond marker on a stem.

symbols.name: Code jurisdiction break
symbols.description: Valve + diamond + code letters (e.g. ASME VIII / ASME B31.3).
symbols.usage: Piping code jurisdiction / scope-of-supply break (* = supplier).
